replace.observe: Read current actual RGB-D scene evidence from selected public views. Use when: another physical camera or derived point-cloud view would resolve uncertainty; the current agentview is already delivered automatically. Effect: read-only; stores derived overlays but neither recaptures nor advances the world. Returns: observation_id, views, view_dimensions, grip_xyz_m, aperture_mm and aperture_limits_mm, with actual-view image blocks; aperture_mm is the normalized Panda opening times nominal 80 mm, not a separately calibrated aperture. Does not: expose object identity, hidden state or task success; derived point clouds add no new sensor evidence. On error: choose agentview, wrist or a named point-cloud view and use the returned native dimensions for pixels.
replace.mark_point: Measure a visible scene point in world metres from an observation-bound pixel. Use when: a precise surface measurement is needed instead of a guessed 3D coordinate; reuse the same point_id only for a complementary view of the same physical point. Effect: read-only world access; persists a local pending or solved measurement record and feedback overlays. Returns: success, point_id, pending/solved/verified status, world xyz_m when solved, source views and action_workspace diagnostics; pending results name next_views. Does not: establish semantic identity, contact, reachability or a grasp; old moving-camera pixels are not current geometry after motion. On error: select a valid interior pixel at the returned view size or use a complementary view; refresh stale evidence after an action.
replace.preview_move: Render one candidate grip-site pose without executing it. Use when: reviewing an uncertain position or orientation before submitting it; skip a repeated preview whose evidence and candidate are unchanged. Effect: read-only world access; persists an observation-bound preview record. Returns: candidate status, preview_id, compiled_pose, candidate_agentview image and view_dimensions. Does not: show actual future world state, solve inverse kinematics or certify scene collision clearance, reachability or task success. On error: correct the named pose field or conflicting orientation representation using the current measured pose.
replace.move_pose: Propose one pose-only bounded OSC command for the right grip site. Use when: current evidence supports one Cartesian target, either direct pose inputs or a current preview_id alone; use a gripper tool for jaw motion. Effect: submits one observation-bound action v3 proposal to the Supervisor and ends this turn; preserves the gripper actuator directive. Returns: submitted status, action and compiled_pose immediately, then a measured receipt and fresh actual observation after execution. Does not: open or close the jaws, guarantee endpoint arrival, provide global motion planning, certify collisions, contact, retention or official task success; contact can change measured jaw state. On error: respect the reported workspace/pose bound, correct or subdivide the target and refresh evidence; stale previews must be recomputed.
replace.close_gripper: Propose a close command while holding the measured current grip-site pose. Use when: current evidence supports closing the jaws; use move_pose for a pose change. Effect: submits one observation-bound gripper-only action v3 proposal to the Supervisor and ends this turn. Returns: submitted status and close_gripper action immediately; the later receipt and fresh observation show measured motion and opening. Does not: move the pose target, establish contact, identify an object or prove retention; nominal aperture is not calibrated contact evidence. On error: wait for a pending action to finish and use fresh evidence before another mutation.
replace.open_gripper: Propose an open command while holding the measured current grip-site pose. Use when: current evidence supports jaw opening; use move_pose for a pose change. Effect: submits one observation-bound gripper-only action v3 proposal to the Supervisor and ends this turn. Returns: submitted status and open_gripper action immediately; the later receipt and fresh observation show measured motion and opening. Does not: establish release at a correct place, invariant measured pose or task success. On error: wait for a pending action to finish and inspect fresh evidence before changing the plan.
replace.report_issue: Record a concise tool or context defect for later inspection. Use when: public evidence or an interface result is inconsistent or lacks an admissible next step; ordinary task difficulty alone is not an interface defect. Effect: writes a local issue record without changing the world or ending the episode. Returns: success after recording the message. Does not: deliver a human answer, repair a tool or change the official verdict. On error: supply one nonempty message describing the concrete evidence or interface defect.
replace.check_task: Read the environment-owned official task result from current public state. Use when: verifying possible completion from actual evidence or confirming the required success latch before finishing. Effect: read-only; no simulation step or robot mutation. Returns: success and task_success Boolean when the checker is available, otherwise an unavailable reason and retryable state. Does not: reveal the predicate, hidden object states or a solution, and unavailable is not a measured false verdict. On error: wait for a valid current observation; do not substitute motion arrival or your own judgment for the checker.
replace.finish_episode: End the policy lifecycle using the observed outcome. Use when: check_task has returned true for success, or supported failure/abort meets the declared contract; do not finish while an action proposal is pending. Effect: persists the policy finish record and ends policy interaction without directly changing the world or evaluator. Returns: success and the accepted outcome. Does not: override the official Boolean verdict or convert a lifecycle declaration into physical success. On error: success needs the checker latch; failure needs a nonempty reason and nonempty exhausted attempts; correct the missing evidence rather than inventing it.
